signature.caption: parallel reviewers, stranger PRs
signature.why: Our pick: a skill written with Claude after hundreds of people's agents sent PRs to the photo-frame repo, with hard rules because those scripts run with sudo on other people's hardware.
signature.quote: Every merge is a decision about what strangers will execute.

history.caption: hands the LLM a kill command
history.why: Our pick: rather than a rule the agent can ignore, he ships a deterministic Vite plugin whose error tells the agent which process holds the port and how to kill it.
history.quote: When `autoKill` is `false` (the default), the plugin throws an error with the PID and a `kill` command you (the llm) can run manually.

also.quote: And the beautiful thing about that is that it is so easy to get the AI to write a deterministic plug in.

archetype.why: Writes his own Vite plugins and skills so agents hit deterministic checks, and rotates agents to compare them.
